The issuer displays solid asset size ($10.15B) and healthy operating profitability with an EBIT of $371M (20.4% operating margin), though net income is lower at $67M. However, creditworthiness is constrained by high leverage (Total Liabilities/Total Assets of 71.3% and Liabilities-to-Equity of 2.53x) and a weak liquidity profile characterized by a current ratio of 0.55 ($475M current assets vs. $857M current liabilities). Balancing the substantial scale and strong operating income against the elevated leverage and tight liquidity supports a lower investment-grade profile.

DECISION: BBB-
